articles.title: Bipartisan Senate Deal Aims to Speed Up Energy Project Approvals
articles.summary: Senators from both parties reached a deal to speed up permits for energy projects and make AI data centers pay for the power they use. Environmental groups say it weakens protections. A vote comes after the midterms.

articles.title: Pentagon Confirms 20% Cut to Generals and Admirals Amid Iran War
articles.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the U.S. military will cut 20% of its generals and admirals by January 2027. He also announced a new drone command. Some lawmakers call it a 'purge.'

articles.title: Trump Administration Reverses Decades-Old Disability Integration Mandate
articles.summary: The Trump administration declined to defend rules requiring people with disabilities to live in integrated settings. A judge removed 'integration' language from Section 504 regulations. Advocates call it unprecedented.
